name: email-love
description: Official Email Love plugins for Claude: build, repair, and migrate export-ready emails and design systems in Figma

plugins.name: email-love
plugins.description: Design and repair production-ready emails in Figma, export clean HTML to any ESP, and audit or migrate existing design systems into the Email Love structure.

plugins.name: emaillove-esp
plugins.description: All ten Email Love ESP templating skills in one install: Braze Liquid, Customer.io Liquid, HubSpot HubL, Iterable Handlebars, Klaviyo Django, Marketo Velocity, MoEngage Jinja, Sailthru Zephyr, SFMC AMPscript, and Zeta ZML. Write, review, and debug personalization code in any email HTML, whatever built or exported it. Sourced at a pinned commit from email-love/esp-skills, the canonical home; install skills individually from that marketplace instead if you only want one platform.
